name: SVS Castle
tagline: Sign up for the castle battle in State vs State

home.subtitle: Tell your leaders when you can fight and how strong your troops are

apply.title: SVS sign-up
apply.notOpenBody: There is no open SVS round right now. Check back later.

step1.title: Player
step1.allianceKnown: We have your alliance from an earlier sign-up. Change it only if you moved.

step2.title: Battle hours
step2.desc: Tap every hour of the battle you will be online for

step3.title: Troops
step3.desc: Pick each troop camp's FC level and your troop tier
step3.tierHint: SVS only counts T10 and T11 troops.

step4.title: Voice chat
step4.desc: Can you talk with us during the battle?
step4.vc: Can you join Discord voice chat?
step4.vcHint: Voice chat helps leaders call the timing. Listening is enough.

errors.troopsRequired: Pick the camp level and the tier (T10 or T11) for every troop type
errors.vcRequired: Tell us if you can join Discord voice chat

admin.adminSubtitle: SVS: sign-ups, hours, troops and exports

settings.battleDesc: When the battle starts and how many hours it lasts. Players pick from these hours. A new round copies them.
settings.error: Could not save the settings. Check the start time and the duration (1-24 hours).

plan.howTo: Drag heroes and players into the plan, or click a slot and then a hero. Every change saves by itself.
plan.minimumsHint: Minimum camp level and tier per troop type. Named joiners below them get a warning.
plan.notesPlaceholder: Anything the state should know about this group
plan.dropToAddLeader: …or drop a sign-up here to make them a rally leader
plan.addGroupHint: A light group for other jobs (e.g. turrets): a name, players and notes.
plan.confirmSingle: Switch to a single alliance? The {{n}} Counter rally leaders move into Main.
plan.confirmDeleteLeader: Delete {{name}} from the plan? Their joiners are removed too.
plan.dragLeader: Drag {{name}} to reorder or move to the other group
plan.pickLeader: Pick the rally leader: name, FID or alliance
plan.disguiseHint: On battle day the leader changes their profile picture to this hero and their name to the alias.
plan.namedJoinersHint: Each one leads with the hero shown; their 2nd and 3rd heroes don't matter.
plan.overrideHint: Leave empty to use the leader's ratio (the usual case).
plan.notSignedUpHint: Added by hand; not in this round's sign-ups.
plan.alreadyUseMove: {{name}} is already in the plan ({{where}}). Use "Move here" to move them.
plan.quickAdd: Quick add a player who didn't sign up
plan.quickAddHint: With an FID they get an SVS sign-up for this round. Without one they stay in the plan only (not signed up).
plan.paletteHero: {{name}}: drag onto a slot, or press to place
plan.paletteHint: Up to generation {{gen}} (the state's hero generation). Drag a hero onto a slot, or click a slot and then a hero.
plan.unplacedCount: {{n}} of {{total}} sign-ups not in the plan yet
plan.unplacedHint: Strongest first. Drag a player onto a joiner row, the extra joiners or "Add rally leader".
plan.conflictBody: A newer version was saved from another screen, so your latest change was NOT saved. Reload to see their version, then redo your change.

share.title: Share with the state
share.off: Only admins can see this plan. Make a secret link to share it (read-only).
share.confirmRotate: Make a new link? The current link stops working at once.
share.confirmDisable: Turn off sharing? The link stops working at once.
share.realNames: Show real names to the state
share.realNamesHint: Disguised leaders also show their real name on the shared page. The PFP and alias are what the enemy sees in game; this only changes our page.

view.title: Battle plan
view.notFound: You're not in this plan. Check the spelling or ask your leaders.
view.joinRules: Everyone else who joins needs at least:
view.notFoundBody: It may have been replaced by a new link or turned off. Ask your leaders for the current link.
view.joinersRatioNote: Joiners use the leader's troop ratio unless an own ratio is shown.

add.title: Add to rally
add.noLeaders: The battle plan has no rally leaders yet.
add.namedHint: The lead hero stays empty: choose it in the Battle plan.
add.bulkAuto: Add them: named places first, then extra ({{free}} places left)

err.conflict: The plan changed while you were choosing. Check the new numbers and try again.
err.gone: That leader or group is no longer in the plan.

deletePlan.leader: They lead the rally {{leader}} ({{group}}); they will be removed from the battle plan too. The rally card stays, without a leader.
deletePlan.joiner: They are Joiner {{n}} with {{leader}} ({{group}}); they will be removed from the battle plan too.
deletePlan.extra: They are an extra joiner with {{leader}} ({{group}}); they will be removed from the battle plan too.
deletePlan.group: They are in {{group}}; they will be removed from the battle plan too.
